report:
Lung, right, pneumonectomy

The specimen consists of a right lung pneumonectomy specimen (720 g, 260 x 180 x 90 mm). The pleural surface is smooth and glistening. Sectioning reveals a firm, grey-white, necrotic, cavitating tumour measuring 45 mm in greatest dimension (45 x 40 x 38 mm), central, involving the main bronchus, 12 mm from the bronchial margin. The remaining lung parenchyma is spongy and unremarkable.

(1-5) Tumour with main bronchus.
(6) Bronchial margin, shave.
(7) Vascular margin, shave.
(8-9) Lymph nodes, station 11R.
(10) Lymph node, station 10R.
(11) Lymph nodes, station 4R.
(12) Background lung.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Pneumonectomy
- Laterality: Right
- Lobe(s): Whole lung
- Tumour site: Central (involving the main bronchus)
- Tumour size: 45 mm in greatest dimension (45 x 40 x 38 mm)
- Separate tumour nodule(s): Not identified
- Pleural surface (gross): Unremarkable

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Invasive squamous cell carcinoma, keratinising
- Histologic grade: G2: Moderately differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour arises in the right main bronchus and infiltrates the bronchial
  wall into the adjacent parenchyma, with distal obstructive pneumonia.
  Immunohistochemistry: p40 positive, TTF-1 negative.
- Spread through air spaces (STAS): Not identified
- Visceral pleura invasion: Not identified
- Lymphatic and / or vascular invasion: Not identified
- Tumour extension: Main bronchus (up to but not including the carina);
  Atelectasis or obstructive pneumonitis extending to the hilar region
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Margins
- Bronchial margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma (closest distance 12 mm)
- Vascular margin: Uninvolved by carcinoma
- Parenchymal margin: Not applicable

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 6 examined; 2 involved
  - Stations (involved/examined): 4R: 0/2; 10R: 0/1; 11R: 2/3
  - Number examined: 6
  - Number involved: 2 (station 11R)
  - Largest metastatic deposit: 9 mm
  - Extranodal extension: Not identified

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not applicable

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT2b pN1
  - Stage group (if cM0): IIB

Additional findings
- Post-obstructive changes
